root_causes.cause: Client read timeout shorter than long SUPERChem generation; retries duplicated still-running work
root_causes.evidence: 300 s ReadTimeout repeated while backend tokens continued and abort counts stayed zero; full 32768 output-token cap can exceed 300 s
root_causes.fix: Read timeout 300 -> 3600 s; per-task wall clock 21600 -> 172800 s; each successful independent trial is atomically journaled with its raw response
root_causes.verification: Actual local HTTP delay reproduced timeout; larger time budget passed; 8 identical-input trials remain 8 independent calls and 8 receipts; resume makes zero additional calls

root_causes.cause: Forced FLASHINFER rejects the Gemma4 partial multimodal full-attention configuration
root_causes.evidence: ValueError: Selected backend AttentionBackendEnum.FLASHINFER is not valid for this configuration. Reason: ['partial multimodal token full attention not supported']
root_causes.fix: Set attention_backend=TRITON_ATTN, whose installed implementation supports mm_prefix; retain model weights, context, no-think and task definitions
root_causes.verification: Installed backend capability inspected; actual GPU startup and 14 native Smol subtasks gated before full evaluation

root_causes.cause: Some multimodal prompts exceed the native 40960 token context; deterministic HTTP 400 was retried unchanged
root_causes.evidence: Observed input length 43917 > 40960. Full CPU scan identifies doc_id 34 (30 images) and 313 (25 images) in each language as overlong estimates
root_causes.fix: Only on the precise context overflow HTTP 400, lower max_dynamic_patch one step at a time until the original complete text and image set fits; keep max_tokens=32768 and no-think. Other 400 errors fail immediately
root_causes.verification: HTTP regression confirms unchanged images/text/generation settings and bounded patch-only recovery; actual offending GPU samples are replayed before full evaluation

preflight_gap: Original checks covered CPU imports, files, prompt templates, selected input loading and metric smokes. They did not launch the attention kernels or generate long/multi-image samples on a GPU.
prevention: New jobs must pass GPU kernel startup and real failure-triggering benchmark requests before full runs. Per-request journals preserve raw output, token usage, finish reason and context adaptation.
final_criteria: All 3 cloud jobs Succeeded; GPU gates passed; full sample IDs and exact repeat counts; 49061 raw responses retained; finite native metrics and no request-failure sentinel.
